name: worker-pod
description: The bridge between the editor's core runtime and VS Code: almostnode-backed language servers (cspell, eslint), the debug adapters' plumbing — every debugger's run-contract events, capability stops, agent control, and the workspace runtime it exports to a debugger (tsval, an interpreter plugged in) — tasks, Source Control and the run picker.

run.debugger.description: The debugger Run (▷) and live runs start: tsval, or another extension's debug type — an interpreter plugged in from editor-contrib. Its `values` and `coverage` events show in the margin as tsval's do.

run.liveRuns.description: Run the program file you're typing in again whenever typing pauses, so the margin shows what it did (LIVE-VALUES.md). A live run makes nothing but reads the policy allows: writes, requests and commands are skipped.

command.description: The command to run, as typed in a terminal (npm run dev).

cwd.description: Where to run it (the workspace, by default).
